versions.changelog:
- Initial release of open-meteo-weather skill.
- Fetches current weather and 7-day daily forecasts for any location worldwide using the Open-Meteo API.
- Supports geocoding to resolve city names to coordinates (no API key required).
- Option to choose between Celsius (default) and Fahrenheit units, remembered per session.
- Presents weather in a concise, user-friendly summary.
- Handles ambiguous city names and API errors with helpful prompts.
